title: Sidewalk Completion Atx
gallery_text: A map of sidewalks and parcels in a historic neighborhood of Austin Texas.
description: This is more of a description of why two datasets that one would think would give a complete picture is actually proving more challenging than assumed. In trying to see the distance between the edge of the public realm to the private entrance I need to first define the edge of the public. This is commonly assumed to be a sidewalk but even for a neighborhood in town that is proving to not be as easy as intended.
